column1: # comment: Sexuality alignments — sexual-orientation values to Wikidata P91 value items, Homosaurus v4 and GSSO; the property to P91. EVERY external identifier was verified against the local authoritative copies (Homosaurus v4 + GSSO from /opt/foundation; Wikidata via API) — scraped IDs proved unreliable (e.g. the v3 numbers did not match). GMEOW applies the SPLIT-ATTRACTION model (sexual orientation and romantic orientation are separate axes); most external vocabularies do NOT distinguish them, so romantic orientation maps only where a distinct term is verified (Homosaurus 'Aromanticism') and is otherwise canonical. schema.org and FOAF have no orientation term — orientation is a documented lossy drop at the projection layer. The value vocab is OPEN; the reified, self-asserted, co-equal gmeow:IdentityFacet machinery is CANONICAL.
